scope.notes: The 6M-active-users milestone. The announcement describes itself as "Three important updates": (1) TEMPORARILY removing the 5-hour usage limit for Plus, Business and Pro — the weekly cap stayed in force; (2) an immediate one-time usage reset landing within the hour of the post, NOT banked and with nothing to redeem; (3) GPT-5.6 Sol made more efficient so a given task burns less quota. The plan list applies to the cap removal specifically. Trigger is demand-surge management plus milestone celebration — GPT-5.6 Sol went GA on 07-11 and the post opens "The last 48 hours of Codex and ChatGPT Work have been intense!". No incident is involved. [migration 02] scope.windows narrowed to ["weekly"]: every source describes the 5-hour window as LIFTED, not refilled — a cap removal is a different primitive from a reset, and is carried in effects[].
